abstract: Mouse early embryos and embryo fragments were transplanted into an immunologically privileged site, consisting of a glass cylinder previously implanted under the skin of adult mice in order to test their tumor producing potential, in allogeneic adult recipients. The highest yield of tumors was obtained upon transplantation of 6 1/2 day old embryos in toto. i.e., including the embryonic and extraembryonic areas. Histological examination showed teratomas composed of differentiated tissues derived from the three germ layers containing isolated foci of undifferentiated cells and nodules of trophoblast giant cells. Areas exhibiting the histological appearance of yolk sac carcinoma were also observed. Transplantation of the whole 6 1/2 day old egg cylinder, including the ectoplacental cone, and the isolated embryonic area produced a lower incidence of teratomas with a reduced variety of differentiated tissues. No yolk sac carcinoma was found in these grafts. The ectoplacental cone of 6 1/2 day embryos produced no tumors. Grafts of genital ridges from 12 1/2 day embryos gave rise to teratomas with well differentiated tissues of embryonic and extraembryonic origin. Areas ressembling yolk sac carcinoma were also observed. The life span of trophoblastic giant cells within the glass cylinder was significantly longer than in other experimental systems.
abstract_ja: マウスの初期胚および胚断片を、成体マウスの皮下に以前埋め込んだガラス円筒からなる免疫学的特権部位に移植し、異系の成体レシピエントにおける腫瘍形成能を検討した。最も高い腫瘍形成率は、胚外組織を含む6日半の胚をそのまま移植した場合に得られた。組織学的検査では、三胚葉に由来する分化した組織を含む奇形腫と、未分化細胞の孤立性の巣、栄養膜巨細胞の結節が認められた。卵黄嚢癌に類似した組織像の領域も認められた。卵筒全体（外胚葉性円錐を含む）と胚の胚性領域のみを移植した場合は、奇形腫の発生率が低く、分化した組織の種類も少なかった。これらの移植片では卵黄嚢癌様の所見は認められなかった。6日半胚の外胚葉性円錐は腫瘍を形成しなかった。12日半胚の生殖隆起を移植すると、胚性および胚外由来の分化した組織を伴う奇形腫が生じた。卵黄嚢癌に類似した領域も認められた。ガラス円筒内における栄養膜巨細胞の寿命は、他の実験系と比べて有意に長かった。
